_note: Every ABA-approved law school in the 50 states plus DC (193 of them). Median GPA and LSAT, tuition, acceptance rate, and the employment/bar figures behind each write-up come from the official ABA Standard 509 disclosures for 2025 (abarequireddisclosures.org), pulled from the ABA's own compilation spreadsheets. About 32 schools report tuition per credit rather than annually; those are annualized at a third of the required credit hours and are therefore approximate. `rank` is the publicly reported US News rank where one exists, and `tier` is derived from it. Write-ups for schools outside the original 12 states are generated from each school's own 509 figures; the rest are hand-written. Point-in-time — spot-check any school against its official 509 report before relying on it. Admissions percentiles (25/50/75 GPA and LSAT, acceptance rate) and employment outcomes (firm-size distribution, employer type, federal and state clerkships, top three states of employment) are pulled directly from the ABA 2025 Standard 509 compilation reports, which describe the class of 2024. Regenerate with tools/fetch_aba.py. Editable.
